title: Too big for the stage
situation: A low ceiling and close side walls, all solid. The dance keeps its beat while every big move is cut down to fit: the arms press flat under the ceiling instead of shooting up, and the side reach stops short of the walls.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.

reach left, short of the wall
